scope: Evidence-backed audit of 42 existing emulator records spanning console, handheld, arcade, computer, calculator/software, and general-purpose machine emulation. Refreshed project activity/release dates and compatibility-facing status; frontend/core and other non-column observations are retained in evidence_note.
